kit: Hidden Harbours — Cliff Face & Terrain Ledge Kit
note: Parametric kit. The PNGs are output, not source — open bake/bake.html to write the full set into a folder.

faces.name: <Rock>_<Aspect>{|_S76|_S62|_S48}{_Lo|""|_Hi}{|_unlit|_normal|_mask}.png
faces.metresAre: surface, not height — a battered face covers 9 m DOWN THE SLOPE
faces.uv: s along the cliff, t down it

channelMeaning: pre-lit albedo at the aspect's fixed key, including the form pass cast shadow. The cheap path.
channelMeaning._unlit: albedo + non-directional cavity and macro AO only. No directional light. Grade- and sun-safe.
channelMeaning._normal: tangent space. R = s, G = t-up, B = out of face, A = cavity+macro AO. Import with sRGB off.
channelMeaning._mask: R = key light N·L including the form cast shadow, G = sky occlusion, B = depth (height field), A = coverage. Same packing as TreeRig2.packMask.

ledges.name: <Rock>{_Lo|""|_Hi}.png
ledges.batter: not authored — a sloped 32 px riser is a different silhouette, not a different shade

profile.name: <Rock>{|_S76|_S62|_S48}.png
profile.encoding: grey, 128 = zero, full 0–255 range maps to ±1.15 m of PLAN displacement
profile.use: subdivide the wall along s at 0.25 m and push each vertex out along the segment normal

batterEffects.light: L rotated into the tipped frame; N·L answers honestly
batterEffects.bedSpacing: × sin(batter) — beds are horizontal in the world, so fewer per texture metre
batterEffects.weathering: colluvium and plants in the hollows and on the benches; seep runs on the face
batterEffects.overhang: undercut bed lip scales with sin(batter); ground bounce falls away

api.face: face(rock, aspect, step, {slope}) -> {data, unlit, normal, mask, W, H, slope}
api.profile: profile(rock, aspect, {slope}) -> {disp, W, H, metres, pxm}

slopeIsContinuous: any angle 30–90 is legal in face() and profile(); ship the four named batters and snap
